3396.listing_description: This is wolgade's topology with a little fix on the lips.
3396.decision: ACCEPTED (CC0). Used: only the genital-region faces (78 verts / 128 tris), cut out and fitted to our hm08 body.
3396.derivation_check: Chain per listings + headers: official MakeHuman female_generic proxy (CC0, 'explicitly released as CC0 in september 2020') -> wolgade nid 757 (CC0, 'derivative work of the female generic topology from the official distribution') -> spamrakuen nid 3396 (CC0, 'a little fix on the lips'). Geometry diff (nearest-vertex, MH units): 83 pelvic vertices of 3396 that are not in the official female_generic have 0 exact matches (<1e-4) in AGPL MHteam nid 85 'Adult Female Genitalia' or nid 98 '(old)' (median distance 0.04 dm), so the simplified genitals are not copied from the AGPL meshes (nid 982/1026 are re-projections of 98/85 with the same geometry, not fetched). No header/licence conflict.
